cards.example_en: These black trousers are too long for the concert.
cards.example_zh: 这条黑裤子去听音乐会太长了。

cards.example_en: A truck delivered the new desks.
cards.example_zh: 一辆卡车送来了新课桌。

cards.example_en: Is it true that Dad bought tickets for the match?
cards.example_zh: 爸爸真的给比赛买了票吗？

cards.example_en: Trust between teammates grew after the long match.
cards.example_zh: 一场漫长的比赛之后，队友之间的信任增强了。

cards.example_en: Mom asked me for the truth about the broken vase.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈要我说出花瓶打碎的实话。

cards.example_en: Let's try the new noodle shop after the concert.
cards.example_zh: 音乐会结束后，我们去尝尝那家新面馆吧。

cards.example_en: He wore a blue T-shirt on sports day.
cards.example_zh: 运动会那天他穿了一件蓝色 T 恤。

cards.example_en: Cars turn left at the bookshop and then go uphill.
cards.example_zh: 汽车在书店那儿向左转，然后往上坡开。

cards.example_en: We watched the news on TV.
cards.example_zh: 我们在电视上看了新闻。

cards.example_en: The ugly duckling became a swan.
cards.example_zh: 丑小鸭变成了天鹅。

cards.example_en: Take an umbrella because it may rain.
cards.example_zh: 带把伞，可能会下雨。

cards.example_en: My uncle works at a hospital.
cards.example_zh: 我叔叔在医院工作。

cards.example_en: The cat is under the table.
cards.example_zh: 猫在桌子下面。

cards.example_en: We took the underground to the museum.
cards.example_zh: 我们坐地铁去博物馆。

cards.example_en: I understand the diagram once the teacher adds labels.
cards.example_zh: 老师加上标注之后，我就理解了这张图。

cards.example_en: We wear a uniform at school.
cards.example_zh: 我们在学校穿校服。

cards.example_en: A meter is a unit of length in our science book.
cards.example_zh: 在我们的科学书里，米是长度单位。

cards.example_en: Scientists study the universe.
cards.example_zh: 科学家研究宇宙。

cards.example_en: She wants to go to university.
cards.example_zh: 她想上大学。

cards.example_en: You will miss the bus unless you leave now.
cards.example_zh: 你现在不走就会错过公交车。

cards.example_en: Wait here until the bell rings.
cards.example_zh: 在这里等到铃响。

cards.example_en: Please stand up and say your name.
cards.example_zh: 请站起来说出你的名字。

cards.example_en: Once upon a time, there was a king.
cards.example_zh: 从前有一位国王。

cards.example_en: The teacher asked us to be quiet.
cards.example_zh: 老师让我们安静。

cards.example_en: We use chopsticks at home and forks at the canteen.
cards.example_zh: 我们在家用筷子，在食堂用叉子。

cards.example_en: We took the usual path through the park.
cards.example_zh: 我们走了公园里平常的那条小路。

cards.example_en: We visited our grandparents on vacation.
cards.example_zh: 假期里我们去看望了祖父母。

cards.example_en: The old stamp has great value to my uncle.
cards.example_zh: 这张旧邮票对我叔叔来说很有价值。

cards.example_en: I added one carrot, my favorite vegetable, to the soup.
cards.example_zh: 我往汤里加了一根胡萝卜，那是我最喜欢的蔬菜。

cards.example_en: The film was very funny.
cards.example_zh: 这部电影很有趣。

cards.example_en: Our victory in the final made the whole school cheer.
cards.example_zh: 我们在决赛中的胜利让全校都欢呼起来。

cards.example_en: Lily filmed a short video of the school play.
cards.example_zh: 莉莉给学校话剧拍了一段短视频。

cards.example_en: The hotel room has a wide view of the sea.
cards.example_zh: 这间酒店房间能看到宽阔的海景。

cards.example_en: My grandparents live in a quiet village.
cards.example_zh: 我的祖父母住在一个安静的村庄。

cards.example_en: She practises the violin every day.
cards.example_zh: 她每天练小提琴。

cards.example_en: Wash your hands to avoid the virus.
cards.example_zh: 洗手以防病毒。

cards.example_en: We visit the science museum with our class each spring.
cards.example_zh: 每年春天我们都和全班一起参观科学博物馆。

cards.example_en: Her voice was clear when she sang in the hall.
cards.example_zh: 她在大厅里唱歌时，声音很清晰。

cards.example_en: Volleyball practice is at four.
cards.example_zh: 排球训练在四点。

cards.example_en: Joining the library club is voluntary this term.
cards.example_zh: 这学期参加图书馆社团是自愿的。

cards.example_en: She works as a volunteer at the library.
cards.example_zh: 她在图书馆做志愿者。

cards.example_en: Students vote for a class monitor at the start of term.
cards.example_zh: 学生们在学期开始时投票选举班长。

cards.example_en: Families wait under the shelter until the rain eases.
cards.example_zh: 家人们在避雨处一直等到雨势变小。

cards.example_en: Birds wake early when the sun hits the garden.
cards.example_zh: 阳光照到花园时，鸟儿很早就会醒来。

cards.example_en: We walk home together when the last class ends.
cards.example_zh: 最后一节课结束后，我们一起步行回家。

cards.example_en: We hung the class photo on the wall by the door.
cards.example_zh: 我们把班级合影挂在了门边的墙壁上。

cards.example_en: I left my wallet in the classroom.
cards.example_zh: 我把钱包落在教室了。

cards.example_en: I want a bowl of hot soup after skating practice.
cards.example_zh: 滑冰训练之后，我想要一碗热汤。

cards.example_en: That long war ended before my grandfather was born.
cards.example_zh: 那场漫长的战事在我爷爷出生之前就结束了。

cards.example_en: Grandma's kitchen felt warm after the snowy walk.
cards.example_zh: 在雪地里走回来以后，奶奶的厨房很暖和。

word.example_en: Her wish to see the sea may come true.
word.example_zh: 她看海的愿望也许会实现。

word.example_en: We try our best in every match.
word.example_zh: 每场比赛我们都尽最大努力。

word.example_en: This puzzle is fun. Have a try.
word.example_zh: 这个谜题很好玩，试一试。

word.example_en: Turn on the fan if you feel hot.
You can turn to your teacher for help.
He did not turn up until noon.
Turn off the lights when you leave.
The rumour did not turn out to be true.
We watched the game on TV.
word.example_zh: 我们在电视上看了比赛。

word.example_en: Ticket prices go up in July.
Please cut up the apples for the salad.
I get up at six on weekdays.
We put up a notice on the board.
word.example_zh: 我们在布告栏上张贴了一则通知。

word.example_en: The school will set up a reading club.
word.example_zh: 学校将建立一个读书社团。

word.example_en: Never look down on a beginner.
word.example_zh: 永远不要看不起初学者。

word.example_en: As usual, she arrived five minutes early.
word.example_zh: 像往常一样，她早到了五分钟。

word.example_en: They are on vacation in Qingdao.
They take a vacation in August.
Wait for me at the school gate.
I wake up before the alarm.
Grandpa will take a walk after breakfast.
I go for a walk after dinner.
There is a map on the wall.
